description: Application-level shortcuts layered on the Svelte 5 data grid's built-in WAI-ARIA keyboard model: Ctrl or Cmd+K opens a command palette, Ctrl+/ toggles a cheat sheet, the vim chord g g jumps to the first row and G to the last, and Escape closes any overlay. Overlays use position fixed with no portals, and the document keydown listener bails when the target is a text input so typing g in the palette does not trigger the chord.

faq.question: How does the chord detection work?
faq.answer: A document keydown listener records the last key and its time; a second g within the chord window jumps to the first row through the API, and any other key resets it. Inputs are excluded by checking the event target.

faq.question: What can the command palette do?
faq.answer: Its commands call the grid API: clear filters with api.clearAllFilters, sort by a column, jump to a row, toggle the cheat sheet. Adding a command is one entry in the list.

faq.question: Why no portals for the overlays?
faq.answer: position: fixed with a high z-index renders above the page even when an ancestor creates a stacking context, so the palette shows inside any layout without moving DOM nodes.
